crossRefs.note: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
“Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation…
Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

translations.web: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

translations.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
